reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the cited text supports it: § 12.3 affirmatively confirms Customer has made no no-hire commitment and preserves Customer's freedom to hire anyone responding to general recruitment, which matches the rule's preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer).
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding and consistent with the instruction not to flag provisions that benefit our party.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are properly explained as artifacts of probing for terms inside a covenant that does not exist; the redline text is unchanged from the original, so no over-editing risk.
Rationale appropriately notes § 12.4's restraint on Vendor as out of scope for this rule, avoiding double-flagging of a counterparty-side covenant.
